root_qualifications: All original drafts are preserved; the intake copies bind exact source evidence inside the registered design and add an explicit design-stop caveat.
Restriction/default is a conditional-applicability specialization; it is not counted as an independent new mechanism family.

A constant ordinal rank can coexist with different physical amounts under different units. Calibration needs a genuinely contrasting frozen interpretation, not a forced ordinal-versus-measurement dichotomy.
Relative comparison can use a fixed reference standard; changing a depicted neighbor matters only if independently established as the relevant baseline.
Nearest attachment repeated across separate operators may imitate wide scope; scope and repeated local predication require distinct predicted endpoints.
